title: A musical program's sound bank: res/musicals/programs/<n>/bank.json
description: Member 3 of the archive ARCID_MUSICAL_PROGRAM + n, the bank that the stage's PlayStrm plays the program's sequence with (GFL_SndBGMSetLoadedData), as res/sound/bank.schema.json's instruments, which tools/data/sbnk.py writes and checks; except that an instrument names its wave archive by its slot, 0 to 3, among the four of the sound archive's bank of the sequence PlayStrm names.

instruments.description: The instruments, in the order of their data, each with the program number that a sequence's program picks it by, as a sound bank's
